## About
DFW Flores Tree Service is a Fort Worth tree company that handles trimming, pruning, tree removal, emergency work, stump grinding and landscaping for residential and commercial customers.
The owner, Jose, comes out to look at your trees, talks through what they need, and gives you a quote. His crew does the work carefully and leaves your yard clean.
Neighbors have given us a 5 star rating across 360 Google reviews. If you have a tree that worries you or just needs a good trim, give us a call.

## Services
- Trim and thin: Trimming and thinning out trees like live oaks and red oaks so they look good and stay healthy.
- Pruning: Pruning trees and shrubs, including cutting out branches lost to freeze damage.
- Tree removal: Taking down trees, including hazardous trees and limbs, with care for your property.
- Emergency tree removal: Help when a tree splits, falls or lands on your house.
- Stump grinding and removal: We grind the stump below the surface. We can leave the wood chips for mulch or haul them off, and we can cover the site with topsoil and seed.
- Storm clean up: Clearing branches and debris after a storm.

## FAQ
Q: Do you give free quotes?
A: Yes. Call us or send a message and we will set up a time to look at your trees and give you a free quote.

Q: Are you licensed and insured?
A: Yes, our company is licensed and insured.

Q: What happens to the wood chips after stump grinding?
A: Your choice. We can leave them for you to use as mulch or remove them.

Q: Do you work with businesses too?
A: Yes. We work with both residential and commercial customers.
